tutorial.page_1:
[u][b]Chapter 1[/b][/u]

[b]The Goal[/b]

The goal of the game is to win two rounds by reaching 21 with numeric cards or get as close as possible.
tutorial.page_2:
[u][b]Chapter 2[/b][/u]

[b]The Turn[/b]

On your turn, you can draw a numeric card or draw/play a Power Card, which grants you abilities during matches.
tutorial.page_3:
[u][b]Chapter 3[/b][/u]

[b]The Relics[/b]

After finishing a match, you choose a relic that will passively help you for the rest of the game.
tutorial.page_4:
[u][b]Chapter 4[/b][/u]

[b]The Loser[/b]

You lose the round if the total value of your cards exceeds 21, or if your opponent obtains a higher sum than yours.
tutorial.page_5:
[u][b]Chapter 5[/b][/u]

[b]The Tie[/b]

When there's a tie or both players exceed 21, no point is awarded no point is awarded, and a new round starts.

common.bell:
[u]The Bell[/u]: 

Play the bell to finish your turn. Then, your oponement can only play once before the round ends. When used in the last turn, just skip it.
common.power:
[u]The Power Deck[/u]: 

Draw 1 card and place it on your hand. You can draw [color=#f5fe05]{0}[/color] cards in this round.
common.number:
[u]The Number Deck[/u] 

Draw 1 card and place it on the board.
common.looser: You lost this match... that's unfortunate.
common.winner: You won this match. Keep going!
common.end: You've won all the 4 opponents! Congratulations!
common.revive: You got a second chance! But your relic was destroyed.

relics.card_13: Permanently adds card 13 to the number deck.
relics.cat_eye: On the 3° round, your opponent’s hidden card will be revealed on the 1° turn.
relics.watch: Right-click this relic to return the last number card you drew to the bottom of the deck (once per match). However, your hand limit for power cards is reduced by 1.
relics.eat_me: Increases your hand limit for power cards by 1.
relics.crown: When you lose a match, this relic breaks and you can try again.
relics.spear: Reduces your opponents’ hand limit for power cards by 1.
relics.tea: Allows you to draw 1 number card after playing a power card on the same turn (once per match).
relics.drink_me: Increases the match goal to 24. Reduces your limit for drawing power cards per round by 1.
relics.hat: When drawing a card that would exceed the match goal, the card is returned and a new one is drawn immediately.
